ZZP0030A is a specific medical classification code used within the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret, or LPR) to document that early mobilization has been initiated for a patient [^src1]. 

Within the context of the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen), this code is essential for national healthcare quality assurance. It directly forms the numerator for [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]], a key performance indicator that measures the proportion of acute surgical patients who are mobilized within 24 hours post-operation [^src1]. By capturing this specific data point—alongside code ZZP0030C, which denotes that there is no clinical indication for early mobilization—health authorities can systematically track regional variations in post-operative care and evaluate adherence to Enhanced Recovery After Surgery (ERAS) protocols across Denmark [^src1].
